protocol.preprocessing: None beyond interval selection and K to Celsius conversion. Original ML/K signals retained; all selected T must be strictly increasing. No measured time supplied; no measured-ramp check claimed.
protocol.selection: Pure Ar and CO because paper states zero order, gives leading-edge cutoffs and energy estimates; both retained regardless of outcome
protocol.full_peak_method: Existing fit_polanyi_wigner fixed zero order depletion profile; max_nfev=200 per boundary, all original selected samples
protocol.independent_leading_edge_method: Bounded scalar energy optimization with least-squares positive amplitude and optional constant offset; no depletion cutoff inside the leading-edge interval
protocol.comparison: Report differences versus published values and quoted uncertainty bands descriptively; not a significance test. Full-peak and leading-edge interval fits need not agree. Do not tune intervals or bounds to recover references.
protocol.limits: Paper supplies leading-edge fit cutoff but not every baseline/window choice; exact published-analysis reproduction is not claimed. Prefactor not directly compared due normalized population and free signal scale.
